questions.prompt: In a circuit model with 24 V across a 6 ohm resistance, what current flows in amperes?
questions.explanation: Ohm's law gives I = V / R = 24 / 6 = 4 A.

questions.prompt: A circuit model has 120 V and 5 A. What is its resistance in ohms?
questions.explanation: Rearrange V = I x R to R = V / I, so 120 / 5 = 24 ohms.

questions.prompt: A modeled load uses 4 A at 230 V. What power does it use in watts?
questions.explanation: P = V x I, so 230 x 4 = 920 W.

questions.prompt: A modeled 8 ohm resistor carries 3 A. Using P = I squared x R, what is the power in watts?
What is the total resistance of 10 ohm and 15 ohm resistors in series?
What is the equivalent resistance of two 12 ohm resistors in parallel?
questions.explanation: Two equal resistances in parallel have half the resistance: 12 / 2 = 6 ohms.

questions.prompt: A simple schematic description places a source, an open switch, and a lamp in one series loop. What is the modeled lamp state?
questions.explanation: An open switch breaks the modeled series path, so current does not flow and the lamp is off.

questions.prompt: A schematic shows two lamps on separate parallel branches. One branch is open. In the ideal model, what happens to the other branch?
questions.explanation: Parallel branches provide separate modeled paths, so opening one does not open the other.

questions.prompt: What is the central purpose of lockout/tagout?

options.B: Control hazardous energy and prevent unexpected startup

questions.explanation: Lockout/tagout controls hazardous energy so equipment cannot unexpectedly energize or start during authorized work.

questions.prompt: What do arc-flash PPE categories communicate at a conceptual level?

options.B: Task-specific protective clothing and equipment requirements tied to assessed hazard

questions.explanation: PPE categories help communicate protection selected from a hazard assessment; PPE never grants permission or makes energized work inherently safe.
